name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl Trifecta
summary: A dumbbell curl combination performed within a single set, transitioning through supinated cross-body curls, pronated cross-body curls, and no-money curls.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding a pair of moderate dumbbells at your sides.
Brace your core and set your shoulder blades back and down.
steps: Perform the prescribed reps of supinated cross-body curls by supinating your forearms and curling across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.
Immediately transition to pronated cross-body curls by turning your forearms into full pronation (overhand grip) and curling across the body.
Finish the set with no-money curls by pinning your elbows against your sides, externally rotating your shoulders, and curling the dumbbells outward away from your torso.
instructions.breathing: Exhale on each concentric curl contraction and inhale as you lower the weights under control.
cues: Keep elbows pinned to your sides during the no-money curls
Control the eccentric phase on every variation
Avoid swinging the torso for momentum

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso to generate momentum as fatigue accumulates.
common_faults.correction: Select a lighter dumbbell weight that allows strict control through all three variations.

common_faults.fault: Flaring the elbows outward during the no-money curl portion.
common_faults.correction: Keep your elbows tucked into your ribs and rotate outward strictly through the shoulders and forearms.

precautions: Do not compromise form or hyperextend the lumbar spine to complete later repetitions.
